# Artifact Keeper 1.11.3

A small patch release on the 1.11 line: 12 changelog entries from 12 pull requests since 1.11.2. The headline is **hosted uploads in 26 native package formats now reach subscribed push and mirror peers on their own** (#4725), closing the replication gap 1.11.2 fixed for Maven, npm and Go. Around it are a rebuilt `buildctl` in the backend image that clears three MEDIUM containerd advisories (#4780), anonymous `npm audit` on public npm repositories (#4317), a configurable upload archive entry-count cap (`MAX_INGEST_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES`, #4093), fixes to the remote-instance relay, the migration items endpoint, Debian migration and `/readyz`, and two fewer sources of misleading WARN lines. **No schema migrations.** One new setting, `MAX_INGEST_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES`, which keeps the previous cap of 10,000 when unset. Alongside the release, 31 security advisories for issues already fixed in earlier releases were published (see [Security](#security)).

## Read this first: what now answers with an error or refuses

- **The remote-instance relay refuses to chain to another relay: `400`** (#4776). `/api/v1/instances/{id}/proxy/{*path}` now rejects paths under `api/v1/instances` instead of forwarding them to the remote's own relay or instance registry. In the same change the relay starts forwarding the caller's query string and `content-type` (it used to drop the first and relabel every body as `application/json`) and relays `content-disposition`, `etag`, `last-modified`, `link` and `x-total-count`. A PATCH relay route follows in 1.12.0.

## Read this second: behaviour that changes without an error

- **Hosted uploads in the native package formats queue a peer push sync task** (#4725). Alpine, Ansible, Bazel, Cargo, Chef, CocoaPods, Composer, Conan, Conda, CRAN, Git LFS, Helm, Hex, Hugging Face, Incus, JetBrains, Pacman, Protobuf, Pub, Puppet, RPM, RubyGems, sbt, Swift, Terraform and VS Code uploads now reach subscribed push and mirror peers without a manual run-now sync. Replicated writes are not pushed back out, and a Conan revision replicates as a whole. OCI/Docker images are still excluded, because the artifact-driven sync worker cannot transfer their blobs. Expect more peer sync traffic on a hosted repository of these formats with a subscribed peer.
- **Anonymous `npm audit` works against a public npm repository** (#4317). `/-/npm/v1/security/advisories/bulk` and `/-/npm/v1/security/audits/quick` are now treated as reads, so an anonymous caller reaches them wherever it may already read anonymously; a private repository still answers `401` and every other npm write still requires authentication. Authenticated read-only members no longer get `403` on them.
- **`MAX_INGEST_ARCHIVE_ENTRIES` sets the upload archive entry-count cap** (#4093) for every format that extracts metadata from an archive. A blank, zero or non-numeric value keeps the default of 10,000.
- **Migration items and reports** (#4778, #4740). `GET /api/v1/migrations/{id}/items` now applies its `status` and `item_type` filters to the page and the total, and orders items that share a `started_at` by id, so pages no longer repeat or skip rows; the report's `summary.failed_items_omitted` counts the failed items beyond the 100 it lists. A migrated `.deb` is filed under its Artifactory `deb.component` property, or `main` for a `pool/<letter>/<name>/` path with no component segment, instead of under the pool letter; re-running a job moves a package an earlier run misfiled (#4797). The source-free backfill from #4740 is scheduled for 1.12.0.
- **The OpenAPI spec marks `curation_default_action` optional on `UpdateRepositoryRequest`** (#4330), so clients generated from the spec no longer have to echo it back on every `PATCH /api/v1/repositories/{key}`.

## Read this third: operations and logging

- **A hung `/readyz` dependency costs the 2 s deadline once per cache window** (#4781), not on every probe: the two racing timers now share one deadline, so the timeout is always cached.
- **Fewer misleading WARNs.** A missing image pulled through an anonymous OCI Remote logs the upstream `401`/`403` at DEBUG instead of an unsampled "Proxy fetch failed" WARN per pull (#4526); refusals of credentialed requests, upstream `5xx` and transport failures still warn. A replica waiting on another replica's proxy single-flight lock no longer logs a sqlx "slow statement" WARN; the wait outcome is logged once at DEBUG with `waited_secs` (#4552).
- **Release tooling** (#4784). `scripts/release/create-release-line.sh` also creates the matching `release/X.Y.x` branch in artifact-keeper-test, and `release-candidate.yml` runs its preflight after the Docker Publish wait instead of racing it. Nothing in the shipped images changes.

## Dependency and image updates

- The backend image's bundled `buildctl` is rebuilt from **BuildKit v0.33.1** (#4780), which vendors containerd v2.3.6 and clears three MEDIUM containerd advisories the push-time Trivy scan of the 1.11.2 UBI image reported: CVE-2026-53493 (fixed in containerd 2.3.6), CVE-2026-53495 and CVE-2026-95838 (both fixed in 2.3.5). No containerd override is carried, nothing is added to `.trivyignore`, and the go1.27.2 toolchain floor and the `golang.org/x/net` v0.60.0 override stay. `buildctl --version` reports v0.33.1. The Alpine image does not ship `buildctl` and is unchanged.

## Security

On 2026-10-19, 31 GitHub security advisories were published for issues that were already fixed in earlier releases (1.11.2 and before). No advisory needs a fix in 1.11.3, and nothing new is disclosed as unpatched. The list is on the [security advisories page](https://github.com/artifact-keeper/artifact-keeper/security/advisories). If you run a release older than an advisory's patched version, upgrading to 1.11.3 covers it.

The full entries are in the `## [1.11.3]` section of [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/artifact-keeper/artifact-keeper/blob/v1.11.3/CHANGELOG.md).
